description: Macro indicators by country and year from the World Bank: GDP, GDP growth, GDP per capita, inflation, unemployment, population, debt to GDP, real interest rate, exports, imports, current account, FDI, or any World Bank indicator code. Up to 10 countries per call (ISO2 or ISO3, joined with ;), newest year first. Pairs with fx_rates. Price $0.003 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"indicator":{"code":"NY.GDP.MKTP.CD","name":"GDP (current US$)"},"series":[{"country":"United States","iso3":"USA","values":[{"year":2025,"value":30769700000000},{"year":2024,"value":29298013000000}]}],"last_updated":"2026-10-08","source":"World Bank Open Data API (CC BY 4.0)"}

country.description: ISO2 or ISO3 code, or up to 10 joined with ;, default US

indicator.description: Alias such as gdp or inflation, or a World Bank code like NY.GDP.MKTP.CD
